risks: We depend on top ten customers for significant portion of the revenue earned from operations.
Also, we depend on the success of our relationships with our customers and we do not have long term contracts with them.

Loss of one or more of our top customers or reduction in business from these top ten customers or any other major clients or a reduction in their demand for our products could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.
We derive a substantial portion of our revenue from our Top Ten customers, and our business is significantly dependent on maintaining strong and continuing relationships with these key clients.

Our operations, particularly in the manufacturing of contemporary and lightweight jewellery with extensive and intricate designs, require continuous engagement with customers who value design innovation, product variety, and timely delivery.
However, we generally do not enter into long-term contracts with these customers and our business arrangements are based on ongoing orders and short-term purchase decisions.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Funding working capital requirements of our Company The jewellery manufacturing business is inherently working capital intensive due to the high value of raw materials, the requirement to maintain adequate inventories, the manufacturing cycle and the credit period extended to customers.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Historically, our working capital requirements have been funded through internal accruals, financing from bank, financial institutions and others.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: However, considering the expected growth in our business operations and the increase in order volumes, we require additional working capital to support the expansion of our business while maintaining uninterrupted manufacturing and timely delivery to customers.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: We manufacture a diverse range of gold jewellery at our own manufacturing facility and supply finished products to wholesalers, retailers and other jewellery businesses based on their requirements.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: We intend to utilize ₹ 2,625.00 lakhs from the Net Proceeds to fund our working capital requirements of ₹ 1,300.00 lakhs in the Fiscal 2027 and ₹ 1,325.00 lakhs in the Fiscal 2028.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: The principal factors contributing to our working capital requirements are as follows: 1.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: High-Value Inventory Gold bullion, pre-casted jewellery and finished goods inventory constitute a significant portion of our working capital requirements given its high intrinsic value.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Consequently, a substantial amount of our working capital remains deployed towards maintaining raw material and finished goods inventories. 2.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: As a result, the conversion of inventory into cash is relatively prolonged, necessitating higher working capital to support day-to-day operations and ensure smooth business continuity. 3.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Consequently, a significant portion of our funds remains invested in trade receivables while production and procurement activities continue, thereby increasing our working capital requirements. 4.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: The acquisition of machinery and equipment to support the expansion and strengthening of our operational capabilities Our Company is engaged in the design, development and manufacture of a diverse range of gold jewellery.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: In line with our business strategy and to support the growing requirements of our customers, we intend to procure additional plant and machinery to augment our manufacturing infrastructure.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: The investment is expected to strengthen our production capabilities and support the future growth of our operations.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: The proposed investment in plant and machinery is intended to augment our manufacturing infrastructure, enhance our in- house production capabilities and support the expansion and diversification of our product portfolio.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: The proposed machinery is expected to facilitate the in-house execution of the chain link making process, which was previously outsourced to third-party manufacturers and service providers.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: Further, the proposed machinery will enhance our capabilities to manufacture additional product categories and components, including beads and also facilitate the development and manufacture of ultra-lightweight jewellery with varied designs and specifications.

other_material_facts.label: capital_expenditure
other_material_facts.value: The proposed machinery is also expected to complement our existing manufacturing infrastructure by enhancing the utilisation and capabilities of our existing production processes across various stages of jewellery manufacturing.

other_material_facts.label: debt_repayment
other_material_facts.value: If there is any increase in the costs of equipment, the additional costs shall be paid by our Company from its internal accruals or borrowings or a combination of both.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: Acquisition of advanced jewellery design software Our Company is engaged in the business of designing, developing and manufacturing a diverse range of contemporary and lightweight gold jewellery on a Business-to-Business ("B2B") model.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: In order to strengthen our jewellery design and product development capabilities and enhance efficiency and precision in the design process, our Company proposes to utilize a portion of the Net Proceeds towards the acquisition of advanced jewellery designing and three-dimensional modelling software.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: The proposed acquisition of new jewellery design software is intended to strengthen our existing design development capabilities by providing enhanced tools for the creation, modification and visualization of jewellery designs, thereby improving the efficiency of our design development process and facilitating the development of designs in line with customer requirements and evolving market preferences.

While the composition of our top customers and the revenue generated from them may change as we add new customers in the ordinary course of business, there can be no assurance that we will be able to do so in a timely manner, or at all, or that we will be able to secure comparable levels of business from other customers to offset the loss of revenue from any of our existing key customers, including our largest customer, or our top five or top ten customers.

Our business remains dependent on ongoing demand from our customers, and any adverse changes in market conditions, shifts in customer preferences or sourcing strategies, increased competitive pressures, or deterioration in the financial condition or business prospects of our customers may result in reduced order volumes, postponement or discontinuation of orders, or loss of one or more customers.

Any sustained reduction in end-consumer demand, adverse changes in consumer preferences, or inability of our customers to effectively market and sell their products could materially and adversely affect our revenues, results of operations, cash flows and financial condition.

Our business is subject to seasonal fluctuations in demand and any decline in sales during peak seasons or any factor negatively impacting discretionary spending by consumers may adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Any such event affecting Gujarat could disrupt our manufacturing operations, delay fulfilment of orders, increase our operating costs, or result in a loss of revenue, and given that we do not have an alternate manufacturing facility located outside the state, we may not be able to readily relocate or scale up production elsewhere to mitigate such disruption.
